# JoiPlay Shortcut Generator 1.0.1

This update refreshes the app identity and clarifies bulk shortcut generation.

## Changes

- Use the new JoiPlay Shortcut Generator launcher icon.
- Rename the bulk action to **Generate all missing shortcut files** to clarify that existing shortcut files are left in place.

Install the generator APK and one of the included modified JoiPlay APKs matching your JoiPlay version. Back up JoiPlay before replacing an existing installation.
